name: super-outer
description: A plain-English translation layer for balanced, evidence-backed engineering

interface.shortDescription: Turns product intent into verified engineering.
interface.longDescription: Translates a product owner's intent into balanced engineering work across UI/UX, frontend, backend, data, security, scale, reliability, architecture, integrations, operations, AI, and delivery. It learns each repository's own system, recommends technical choices itself, and asks only consequential questions in ordinary English.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Super-outer to translate this product intent into balanced engineering work. Explain choices and proof in ordinary English.
